holds.reason: Primary interview portraits available in this pass are only small files. A genuine HD portrait or documented teaching image is still needed; the author-name search also returns unrelated people and is not evidence of identity.

The manual remains a remotely hosted PDF and the software screens are low native resolution. The high-resolution EA poster scan is all rights reserved with no separate image-reuse grant, so it is not admitted.

No qualified licensed HD image of Monica’s actual adaptation artwork, the squared-paper production drawings or Pagano’s support work is admitted. General Zeebo pictures and uncredited blog illustrations are not substitutes.
Primary interview images of development participants and prototypes are genuinely small; no enlarged version is manufactured.
The Famicom cartridge supports the separate home-version discussion but is not assigned to the bubble-effect implementation card.

research_rejections.reason: This Wii-shaped Club Nintendo product is a TELEVISION REMOTE, with Japanese channel/volume labels; it is not the Wii game controller. Rejected after full-image and source-title inspection.
The actual DK Bongos original is only 1280 x 960; a different licensed documentary photo is used.
The historical URL no longer exposes the requested original photo. Related-photo bootstrap data is rejected rather than treated as the requested asset.
